svg.title: Distinguishing D-glucose from D-fructose
svg.text: which tests work — and which do not
Rule: choose a test that detects an ALDEHYDE (Br₂/H₂O) or a KETOSE (Seliwanoff) — not just “a reducing sugar”.
Hot HNO₃ also differs: glucose → saccharic acid (chain intact); fructose → tartaric + glycolic acids (C–C cleavage).
